text.tspan: Population whose cause of death is registered
The estimated share of people in each country whose cause of death is registered in the national vital
registration system. If all deaths were registered with a cause of death, the chart area would be full.
Data source: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory (2026)
Note: Data points are taken as single-year observations between 2007 and 2016, depending on the country. The total number of deaths is
estimated using data from household surveys and censuses. Where data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2013
